subject: Audit log handover, export guarantees and deletion assurances
messages:
From: Jane Park <security@acmehealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: 2028-01-11T16:12:00Z
Subject: Audit log export + deletion guarantees (initial ask)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing a regulatory evidence bundle and need a clear answer on Redwood's audit/access log export capabilities and deletion assurances for our tenant (AcmeHealth). A few specific asks: 

- What are your default retention periods for audit/access logs on the hosted platform vs Dedicated/Private?
- Which export formats do you support (NDJSON, Parquet, syslog, CSV)? Can we get a sample schema or manifest?
- Is export encrypted in transit and at rest? Do you support customer-managed keys for exported artifacts (KMIP/KMS)?
- When we request a full handoff, what is the typical turnaround (bulk export timeline)? Do you include checksums and a manifest for chain-of-custody?
- When we request deletion, what processes guarantee removal from primary and backups? Is there overlap (backup retention window) we should plan for?

We're on a firm timeline for an audit week beginning 2028-01-30 and need to plan the logistics. If it helps, we can sign an export agreement — I'll loop Legal if needed.

Appreciate a concise Q&A and any attachments (schema, matrix) you can provide.

Best,
Jane Park
Head of Security Operations
AcmeHealth
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-01-11T20:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit log export + deletion guarantees (initial ask)

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise Q&A and I attached a sample export schema (export_schema.csv) and our retention matrix (retention_matrix_v2.pdf) for quick reference.

High-level answers (hosted / Dedicated / Private):
- Default retention (audit/access logs): hosted = 90 days (rolling); Dedicated = negotiable (typically 1–3 years depending on commitment); Private = customer-configurable and can be set to meet regulatory requirements.
- Export formats: NDJSON (recommended for log ingestion), Parquet (large bulk exports), compressed CSV, and raw syslog streams for realtime pulls. The attached CSV shows field names, types, and example rows.
- Encryption: exports are delivered over TLS 1.3; at-rest encryption is AES-256. For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). For Hosted, we can provide export artifacts encrypted with a customer-provided PGP key as an alternative.
- Manifest & checksums: every bulk export includes a manifest (JSON lines) with file list, record counts, md5/sha256 checksums, start/end cursor timestamps, and an export token. This is included in the export bundle.
- Bulk export timeline: standard SLA is 7–10 business days for a full tenant export (size dependent). Expedited handling is possible for legal/regulated requests; we will surface costs and a firm ETA in the export agreement.
- Deletion guarantees: primary data is deleted on request and we publish a deletion manifest with the affected time windows and record counts. For hosted customers there is a 30-day cold-backup overlap (this allows safe restore in disaster scenarios) after which backups are rotated and overwritten; we provide a signed attestation when complete. Dedicated/Private offers tighter controls (we can configure shorter or zero backup overlap depending on contract).

Next steps 
- If this matches what you need, please confirm and we will open a ticket to schedule the export and generate the export agreement.
- I'll CC Legal to draft an export/attestation addendum if you want a DocuSign.

Tagging Markus and Marissa to confirm SFTP options and KMS specifics.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: export_schema.csv, retention_matrix_v2.pdf

Hi Olga / Jane,

Thanks for the detailed summary. A couple of follow-ups from our side before we lock timelines: 

1) Legal hold: If AcmeHealth places a legal hold on a subset of records, how is that indicated in the manifest and what happens to scheduled deletion for those windows?
2) Cross-border considerations: If the export needs to be delivered to an EU region but the backups currently sit in us-east-1 for disaster recovery, can you guarantee no cross-border copy persists after export + deletion?
3) Delivery options: do you offer SFTP with client cert auth or customer-provided S3 location with pre-signed URLs? Any constraints on file size / single-file > 100GB handling?

We prefer a solution where exported artifacts are encrypted with our key and transferred to an EU-managed S3 bucket. If not possible for hosted, we need a formal statement of residual risk for the audit.

Thanks,
Finvero Compliance (on behalf of AcmeHealth)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Finvero Compliance Team <compliance@finvero.com>, Jane Park <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-01-13T23:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit log export + deletion guarantees (operational clarifications)

Hi all — quick operational clarifications to close this out: 

- Legal hold: we mark held time windows in the export manifest under a "holds" section (hold_id, start_ts, end_ts, reason, ticket_ref). Records under active hold are excluded from any deletion flow until hold is released; deletion manifests will explicitly list suppressed windows.
- Cross-border copies: for Hosted customers our standard disaster recovery may create ephemeral copies in us-east-1; however, we can perform a targeted export and deletion run and provide a signed attestation of no remaining copies outside EU after backup rotation (note: backup rotation window applies — default 30 days). For Dedicated/Private deployments, data residency is enforceable by configuration and we can provide physical-region-only exports.
- Delivery options: supported methods = SFTP (client cert), customer S3 (pre-signed URL or cross-account put), HTTPS push to customer endpoint. Large-file handling: we chunk files > 50GB by default and include chunk manifests; single-file > 100GB can be accommodated via multipart upload to S3.
- Customer-managed keys: available for Private deployments. For Hosted, we offer PGP-encrypted artifacts or a process to encrypt with a customer-supplied key prior to upload; full KMS with CMK is available on Dedicated where we can grant limited key access in the export workflow.
- Backups & snapshots: hosted cold backups have a 30-day overlap; we provide a deletion attestation once those backups are rotated and can't be recovered. If Acme requests immediate certification of destruction, we can schedule an expedited wipe with a published ETA + small service fee.

Action items:
- Jane / Finvero: confirm you want a standard export + 30-day attestation OR request expedited immediate wipe (we'll provide cost/ETA).
- Olga / Marissa: I'll prepare the DocuSign export agreement and the technical handoff plan (SFTP cert or EU S3 details).

Markus Klein
Director, Platform Security Operations
Redwood Inference
